**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Build (levels 10-60), 43/8/0 — no respec, one build from level 10 to 60. The decision loop walks 116 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 60 (1 member). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/mage/arcane/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). No measured numbers for this spec: it has no row in the round-155 table, which lists the 14 specs with boss-fight data [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. ## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### AoE

- **125 — Arcane Explosion** (`MA14-arcane-explosion`) — level 14+ · intent `filler` · spell 1449
  - **When:** in combat; at least 3 engaged enemies within 10 yd; the target is within 10 yd; at least 75 mana; (the tank has opened threat on the target or the lowest party health below 0%); not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 12 yd.

Two branches, so it never re-casts on a sheep with time left: a mob with no sheep aura (any of the four ranks 118, 12824, 12825, 12826) is sheeped while two or more enemies are engaged on the party (the marked mob itself counts once it is awake and attacking, a sheeped one attacks nobody, so the second case needs one other enemy: the last mob standing is never sheeped); a mob that carries the sheep is sheeped again only under 3 s left (target.aura_ms, v17) and while at least one other enemy is engaged.

- **MA16w-shoot-trash — Shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-065 (owner approved, via the orchestrator: the mage spends to empty on every trash fight, 28 of 56 fights under 20 per cent in round 86, and drinks after almost every pull; wand earlier on trash, keep full nukes for bosses and big pulls): the wand instead of a nuke when the target is under 30 per cent health, or the mage is under 40 per cent mana, in a fight that is not a boss or a big pull. Boss and big-pull test, from what a rule can read in combat: `not (target.ttd_ms >= 15000)` (a target the party will take 15 s or more to kill is a long fight; null reads true, so a fresh target is trash until it proves otherwise) and `enemies_engaged_within(30) <= 3` (a pack of four or more keeps the nukes and the area spells).
- **MA13-arcane-missiles — Arcane Missiles:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MA15-frostbolt — Frostbolt:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand. HO-TKB-PLAY-189 (HO-188): not on Noxxion (13282, Razorfen Downs boss), whose creature_template school_immune_mask is 16 = frost `db:penqle_world.creature_template@tkbplay-189`; a stopgap until p1-loop's target.school_immune(k) (v40) lands, then it is replaced by the vocabulary term.
- **MA15a-fireball — Fireball:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MA16-shoot — Shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031): also while a ritual is on below 40 per cent mana (not on a boss), where the spenders hold back for the area wave. Measured on d-20260917T070130Z-p3, actor 358: the wand was 26 per cent of the mage''s casts, 86 per cent of its starts were unasked, 7 ticks were wand-locked, and 35 of its own casts came back SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED -- the bot''s own movement cancelling its own auto-repeat.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **MA00e-conjure-food-2:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MA00e-conjure-food-1:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MA00d-conjure-water-2:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MA00d-conjure-water-1:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MA12-arcane-rupture:** Elite is the proxy for high-HP: the guide gives no health number (proposed open question P272-1). The Rupture debuff test (page: if the debuff is not active) is not written: DB 52502, the Missiles-boosting aura, lasts 8 s and has the caster as its target, but spell row 51949 carries no effect that applies it, so which aura id lands cannot be read from the data; the 15 s Rupture cooldown stays the pacing (proposed open question P330-3).
- **MA11-arcane-surge:** The last-second-of-the-debuff timing of L129 is not expressible (P330-3).
- **MA14f-fire-blast-execute:** The under-30-per-cent execute line is the one the frost file already uses (MF14) and the guide gives no number (proposed open question P272-2).
